title: buildReference
description: Keys a cache on the size and modification time of every file in the product's data folder, Lathe's data folder and the migrations, and returns the kept reference while the key matches. Otherwise it opens the product's store, runs `referenceOf` on its schema, kind order and check rows, keeps the answer (clearing the cache past 16 entries) and closes the store.

title: show
description: Opens the product's store for the call and closes it after: the row comes from the store, the part rows from each part table by its owner column, the parent and children from `record_parent`, the scope from `record_scope`, and the links from a pass over every relation's rows in both directions. Nothing is kept between calls.

title: list
description: Opens the product's store for the call and filters the table's rows: by the kind's parent columns, by `record_scope` for a kind with no owner, by the owner column for a part table, or by either end for a link table.

title: nextId
description: Opens the product's store for the call, checks the parent against the kind's parents and ID scope, takes the ID's start from `record_scope`, and scans every kind's IDs for the highest number of the pattern's shape. A flow's number comes from a query for the first interface of the product that the use case has no flow through.

title: findDataFile
description: Runs in the desktop main process: each record action's channel accepts only `{ id }` (`parseRecordId`), an ID of record shape, so a page never names a file. `DataFiles` returns the file it last found while that file still holds the ID; otherwise `findDataFile` reads each `.jsonl` file of each product's data folder, in name order, for a line starting with the record's `id`, and the match is remembered.

title: badgeFor
description: Worked out in the desktop app's main process each time a window reports its count, gains focus or closes: each page sends its error count over `lathe:error-count`, `parseErrorCount` keeps only a whole number up to a million, and `badgeFor` picks the focused window's count, or the last focused one's while another app is in front, which `badgeText` shows as nothing at 0 and as `999+` above 999.

title: RecordContent
description: `RecordContent` looks the ID up in the index it is given (the current space's) on each render and draws the page from it: the record's text, its kind's sections, its children from `children` (leaving out an aggregate's events, a flow's steps and a use case's flows, which have sections of their own), its problems from `problemsFor`, and its facts and links; nothing is kept between renders.

title: findItems
description: `findItems` lists every record of the space's index, every kind's format page and every check as one item, once per index; `rankItems` scores the items against the typed text on each keystroke, sorts by score then ID and keeps the first twenty.

title: RecordForm
description: `Editable` opening a form: `RecordForm`, generated from the schema.

title: SpaceItems
description: The space's folders, drawn by `SpaceItems` from `productFolders` and `domainFolders`.

title: DomainWiki
description: `DomainWiki` draws the domain's page from the space's index on each render: its stage sections from `domainFolders` (worked out once per index), filtered by the page's search; the records no folder lists, found by walking every folder's records and what folds under them; its coverage from `coverage`; and its problems from `problemsUnder`.

title: GroupWiki
description: A group's page, `GroupWiki`, in the wiki card.

title: neighborhood
description: neighborhood, treeColumns, the group functions

title: erdFocus
description: erdMap, erdFocus, erdStrength and scopeContents: the product's map, and what a focus fades, picks out and frames on it.

title: recordTables
description: `recordTables` finds the record's tables from the schema and its kind; `recordHistory` then runs `git log -G` over those data files for lines whose first column is the ID, reads each listed commit's diff with `git show` four at a time, and turns the output into commits (`parseLog`) and changes paired by key (`changesInDiff`), with the uncommitted ones from `git diff HEAD` and untracked files. Nothing is kept between requests.

title: ProductsPicker
description: The products picker, `ProductsPicker`, and the rail's list, `SpaceRail`.

title: recordChanges
description: recordChanges compares two sets of tables by record: its own row, the part rows it owns and the links it starts; rowDelta and applyDelta keep a moment as a commit plus the rows that differ from it.

title: loadWorkspace
description: `loadWorkspace` reads the config with `loadConfig`, opens the store afresh on each call and reads the workspace from it (`readWorkspace`), closing the store after; when the store refuses the data it answers a workspace of `data-refused` errors instead.

title: specData
description: The SpecData answer, `specData`: one store per product root, opened afresh when its files change; `dataSignature`.

title: listKeyboardCommands
description: Is given the keymap's reader and answers from it alone.

title: listThemes
description: Is given the themes' reader and answers from it alone.

title: getThemeFile
description: Is given the themes' reader and answers from it alone: the theme written as its file.

title: listRecentFolders
description: Is given the recent folders' reader and answers from it alone, as File › Open Recent lists them.

title: watchTargets
description: The change event stream of `lathe serve`: watches the product's data folder and Lathe's own data and schema (`watchTargets`) and sends spec:changed to every open event stream.

title: listSessions
description: Reads each transcript's ends for its title, and the CLI's registry of running sessions.

title: focusAnswer
description: Reads what the focus page registered (useViewState) and names it from the index; the MCP server's callAppTool reaches it through the bridge.

title: wholeChat
description: Answers with the window's chat as one patch and notes it as sent, so the next patch follows from it.

title: COVERAGE_COUNTS_SQL
description: Worked out on every load by `computeCoverage`, which runs `COVERAGE_COUNTS_SQL` over the `coverage_count` view on a connection of its own, beside the gap, test, proof and standing queries, and groups the rows by product and domain into each scope's `Coverage.obligations`.

title: COVERAGE_GAPS_SQL
description: Worked out on every load by `computeCoverage`, which reads `COVERAGE_GAPS_SQL` from the `coverage_gap` table on a connection of its own, beside the other coverage queries, and puts each scope's gaps on its `Coverage.gaps`.

title: COVERAGE_TESTS_SQL
description: Worked out on every load by `computeCoverage`, which reads `COVERAGE_TESTS_SQL` from the `coverage_tests` view on a connection of its own and makes one `Coverage` entry per scope from its rows, holding the counts as `tests`.

title: patternsFollowedBy
description: patternsFollowedBy, followingDomains, ruleStatus (reads Coverage.pattern_rules)

title: traceOf
description: Worked out in the app from the space's index each time the section draws: `traceOf` reads the record's chain from `Workspace.chains`, `judge` decides designed, built and proved in each domain `owingDomains` names, from coverage's gaps and `proved_by`, and `isBuilt` marks a build record whose file no check reports missing.

title: traceChain
description: `traceChain` reads the obligation's chain, its gaps and whether only proof is asked of it from the Trace read (list-traces, LA-TRC-QRY15), once per answer and index, and gives null for a record that is not an obligation.

title: test-file-missing
description: The file checks: the test-file-missing, test-file-missing-id, manual-test-file-silent, technical-file-missing and test-case-unnamed checks, each a query of file_facts (test-case-unnamed of test_case too).

title: gatherRouteFacts
description: gatherRouteFacts, namesRoute and servedRoutes, written into route_facts and served_routes by writeRouteFacts; the gap rule ROUTE_GAP_RULES.

title: table-schema-mismatch
description: A check row in `lathe/data/check.jsonl`, run with the other checks after every load: its SELECT reads the `table_facts` rows not found and words one warning per missing part, ordered by record, then the table, its columns and its primary, unique and foreign keys.

title: getFollowing
description: `getFollowing` is given the read model's reader by the query runner and answers from it alone; it changes nothing.

title: listFollowings
description: `listFollowings` is given the read model's reader by the query runner and answers from it alone; it changes nothing.

title: readPackageFacts
description: `readPackageFacts` reads the manifests into `package_facts` before the checks run; `PACKAGE_GAP_SQL` is the package-not-accounted-for gap rule.

title: traceMatrix
description: Worked out in the app from the space's index and the Trace read (list-traces, LA-TRC-QRY15): `traceMatrix` takes `obligationsUnder` the focus in the nav tree's order and groups each one's chain, read once per answer and index, by its parent; for a focus with no obligation under it, `traceShape` gives the rows of the chains that hold it (`holdersOf`), or the matrix of the nearest container with obligations below it.

title: listFollowers
description: `listFollowers` is given the read model's reader by the query runner and answers from it alone; it changes nothing.

title: listTraces
description: `listTraces` is given the read model's reader by the query runner, over the data with the checks' run, and answers from it alone; it changes nothing.
